additional_info.subject: RE: ID0459580-DC/Si-D/AT-[MP / S4 170003530] Abnormal DC ContacottrQA13-14 CRM:03098000158
additional_info.body:
Dear
Johannes
,
Regarding the error related to
DC Contactor QA13–14
, please note that this behavior is
normal
.
The feedback is acknowledged through
voltage measurement
, and occasionally, the voltage does not decrease to the minimum level within the logic timer.
This can cause the system to register a temporary fault, but it does not indicate a issue.
With best regards,
Younes Baroudi
eMobility Technical Support Team

The feedback is acknowledged through

additional_info.subject: ID0459580-DC/Si-D/AT-[MP / S4 170003530] Abnormal DC ContacottrQA13-14 CRM:03098000158
additional_info.body:
Dear Johannes,
As mentioned before, the behavior you see with the DC Contactor
QA13–14
is normal.
The system checks the contactor status by measuring the voltage. Sometimes, when the contactor opens, the voltage does not drop completely within the time set by the logic. Because of that, the system temporarily shows a fault — but this does not mean there is a real problem with the hardware.
With best regards,
Younes Baroudi
eMobility Technical Support Team
